data.name: Outlook: Reply to Email
data.description: Reply to an email in Microsoft Outlook by providing the message ID and reply text.
data.instructions:
Reply to an existing email in Microsoft Outlook.

Provide the message ID of the email to reply to and the reply body text.

**Inputs:**
- {message_id}: The ID of the email message to reply to
- {reply_body}: The text content of your reply

**Output:** {result} contains the reply confirmation.
